english.title: Failure to take action in accordance with a remedial notice - Anti-Social Behaviour Act 2003
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[owner]_
(B)_[occupier]_

of land,**(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), which was the subject of a remedial notice under section 69 of the Anti-social Behaviour Act 2003 requiring action to be taken in respect of a complaint made under Part 8 of the Act by

(C)_[the owner, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), of a domestic property, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..), that his reasonable enjoyment of that property was being]_
(D)_[the occupier, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), of a domestic property, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..), that his reasonable enjoyment of that property was being]_
(E)_[an owner, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), of a domestic property, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..), that was for the time being unoccupied, the reasonable enjoyment of that property by a prospective occupier of that property would be]_

adversely affected by the height of a high hedge situated on your land, failed to take the required remedial action, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ACTION..),

(F)_[within the compliance period]_
(G)_[by the time by which it was required to be taken]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 75(1) of the Anti-social Behaviour Act 2003.
